en-US.name: Energy Display Voice
en-US.summary: Ask Alexa about your Home Assistant solar, grid and battery.
en-US.description: Exposes your Home Assistant energy data as read-only Alexa devices (Solar, Grid, Battery, Home Energy) so you can ask for values and use them in routines. Requires the Alexa Energy Display integration.
examplePhrases: Alexa, what is the solar power?
